title: Choose a reading path through Sounds of Odisha
observed_gap: The collection separates eight core introductions from ten further-reading stories. A reader interested in voices, instruments, dance or place must traverse both lists without a cross-collection thematic entrance.
basis: Editorial reading suggestions based on the existing canonical article titles and introductions. These are overlapping ways to approach the collection, not exclusive cultural categories, historical chronology or recommended live performances.
intro: Start with what draws you in. These paths connect the stories below; each offers a different question to carry into your reading.
note: These are reading suggestions, not fixed categories. A voice, an instrument and a dance often belong to the same story.

paths.title: Begin with a voice
paths.question: Who carries the words, and who answers?

paths.title: Follow an instrument
paths.question: How do breath, hands and movement bring it into an ensemble?

paths.title: Listen through movement
paths.question: What can the music tell you beyond the striking pose?

paths.title: Stay with a place
paths.question: What changes when you listen to work, water and the people around them?

limits: No new historical claims, audio, recording rights or current performance offers.
All titles and destinations are drawn from existing canonical discovery entries.
Eight core chapters, full further-reading cards and search eligibility remain unchanged.

story_navigation.observed_gap: Reading paths were available only on the collection. Individual stories offered a core-only sequence or contextual links, leaving readers without the full four-path chooser or current-story context.
story_navigation.behavior: Reuse the same compact native disclosure on all21 story pages; mark the current story and its path, use canonical discovery labels and destinations, and retain existing narrative, sources and links.
story_navigation.limitations: Editorial reading suggestions, not cultural classification, chronology, live performances or new factual research.
